The claim grid (2097152, 1, 1), 2097152 = 2^31 / 1024, keeps offs = pid * 1024 + tl.arange(0, 1024) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the loads of orderkey_ptr and quantity_ptr are masked by offs < n_elements, and the atomic add at sums_ptr + keys uses the index-in values of orderkey_ptr (the plan sizes sums_ptr from the maximum of the same keys).

The claim grid (1048576, 1, 1), 1048576 = 2^31 / 2048, keeps offs = pid * 2048 + tl.arange(0, 2048) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the six column loads are masked by offs < n_elements (the price and discount loads by keep, a subset), the scalars are compared only, and out_ptr is added to at 0 of its 1 element.

pid = tl.program_id(0) indexes ps_partkey_ptr and ps_suppkey_ptr with no bound check; the plan launches exactly n_ps programs, but any grid with more than n_ps programs reads past the end of both buffers. The probe slots (h + probe) & table_mask lie in [0, table_mask], inside the table_mask + 1 entries of the three tables.

The claim grid (8388608, 1, 1), 8388608 = 2^31 / 256, keeps offs = pid * 256 + tl.arange(0, 256) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the loads of the three lineitem columns are masked by offs < n_lineitem, and the probe loads of ht_idx_ptr, ht_part_ptr, and ht_supp_ptr use (h + probe) & table_mask, inside the table_mask + 1 entries. The atomic add to sum_qty_ptr + found_idx (n_ps elements) uses the value cand read from ht_idx_ptr, checked only for cand >= 0; it stays below n_ps only because _insert_ps_kernel stored partsupp row numbers there, contents that an earlier kernel wrote and the gate cannot establish; a ht_idx_ptr entry of n_ps or more at a matching slot writes past sum_qty_ptr.

pid = tl.program_id(0) indexes ps_suppkey_ptr, ps_availqty_ptr, and sum_qty_ptr with no bound check; the plan launches exactly n_ps programs, but any grid with more than n_ps programs reads past the end of the three buffers. The probe slots (h + probe) & table_mask lie in [0, table_mask], inside the table_mask + 1 entries of supp_set_ptr.

The claim grid (8388608, 1, 1), 8388608 = 2^31 / 256, keeps offs = pid * 256 + tl.arange(0, 256) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0, and its y = z = 1 removes a repeated selection; the loads of s_suppkey_ptr and s_row_idx_ptr are masked by offs < n_supplier, the probe loads of supp_set_ptr use (h + probe) & table_mask, inside its table_mask + 1 entries, and count_ptr is added to at 0. The kernel appends at base + prefix, base = tl.atomic_add(count_ptr, block_total), into out_idx_ptr (n_supplier elements) without checking the position; with at most n_supplier found rows, it stays below n_supplier only because the plan zeroes count_ptr, a precondition on count_ptr's contents on entry that the gate cannot establish; a count_ptr value of n_supplier or more on entry with one found supplier writes past out_idx_ptr.

The claim grid (8388608, 1, 1), 8388608 = 2^31 / 256, keeps offs = pid * 256 + tl.arange(0, 256) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the loads of l1_late_ptr, supp_ids_ptr, and l1_orderkey_ptr are masked by offs < n_l1; the binary search keeps 0 <= low <= mid < high <= lo_n and masks the load of lo_orderkeys_ptr + mid by mid < lo_n, and the loads of the two statistics at idx = low by idx < lo_n; the atomic add to counts_ptr + safe_supp_id uses the index-in values of supp_ids_ptr (0 for the masked lanes), inside counts_ptr.

The claim grid (2097152, 1, 1), 2097152 = 2^31 / 1024, keeps offs = pid * 1024 + tl.arange(0, 1024) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the loads of acctbal_ptr and in_mask_ptr are masked by offs < n_elements, and the atomic adds use the constant indices stats_ptr + 0 and stats_ptr + 1 of its 2 elements.

The claim grid (2097152, 1, 1), 2097152 = 2^31 / 1024, keeps offs = pid * 1024 + tl.arange(0, 1024) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the load of o_custkey_ptr is masked by offs < n_orders, and the store to bitmap_ptr + safe_key by 0 <= key <= max_key (safe_key is 0 for the masked lanes), inside the max_key + 1 bytes.

The claim grid (2097152, 1, 1), 2097152 = 2^31 / 1024, keeps offs = pid * 1024 + tl.arange(0, 1024) below 2^31, so the 32-bit offset does not wrap and offs >= 0; the four customer loads are masked by offs < n_elements, the load of bitmap_ptr + safe_key by 0 <= key <= max_key (safe_key is 0 otherwise), inside the max_key + 1 bytes, stats_ptr is read at 0 and 1 of its 2 elements, and the atomic adds to counts_ptr + code and sums_ptr + code are masked by 0 <= code < 100, their length.

the kernel uses no program id, so every program of any grid does the same accesses: offs = tl.arange(0, 128) loads counts_ptr and sums_ptr masked by offs < 100, their length; the stores at pos = cumsum(valid) - 1 (0 for the masked lanes) are masked by valid, which needs offs < 100, so pos < 100, inside the three 100-element outputs; num_groups_ptr is written at 0 of its 1 element.
